name: Lanser Alm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Lanser Alm – a true alpine paradise in the heart of Tirol!**

Nestled at **1,500 meters** above sea level, this iconic mountain hut offers breathtaking views of the **Kitzbühel Alps** and the **Zillertal Valley**. Whether you're here for a hearty meal of **Tiroler Gröstl**, **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle**, every bite is a taste of authentic **Tiroler** hospitality.

**Hiking, relaxation, or adventure?** The **Lanser Alm** is your gateway to endless possibilities. Explore the **Lanser Bergbahnen** trails, enjoy a refreshing dip in the **Almsee Lake**, or simply unwind with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** and a view that takes your breath away.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Kitzbühel**, and **Mayrhofen**, the **Lanser Alm** is the perfect retreat for nature lovers, families, and anyone craving a taste of the **Tiroler** way of life.

**Come and experience the magic of the Alps – where tradition meets adventure!** 🏔️✨
